thag1.119:1.2: Both Bodhi here and Bodhi in the parallel in the parallel at [sn9.5:2.2]() read _osiya_ here, “having placed”, which agrees with the commentarial gloss.
thag1.119:1.3: Ānanda is addressed as Gotama in the parallel at [sn9.5:2.2](), but he was not a Vajjian, and the verse is not among his collected in [thag17](). Saccaka, another Vajjian, is addressed by a different brahmanical clan name, Aggivessana ([mn35:4.2]()).
